package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"

	"github.com/gorilla/mux"
)

// scenario for multiple_bind_sources_into_same_struct_without_precedence_contract: One DTO being filled from body, query, and path without a clear precedence policy.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type SearchParams struct {
	Query    string `json:"query" form:"query"`
	Page     int    `json:"page" form:"page"`
	Category string `json:"category" form:"category"`
}

func SearchHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var params SearchParams

	json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&params)

	vars := mux.Vars(r)
	if q, ok := vars["query"]; ok && params.Query == "" {
		params.Query = q
	}

	if p := r.URL.Query().Get("page"); p != "" && params.Page == 0 {
		params.Page, _ = strconv.Atoi(p)
	}
	if c := r.URL.Query().Get("category"); c != "" && params.Category == "" {
		params.Category = c
	}

	json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(params)
}
